query:
UPDATE webhook_delivery
            SET
                status = $2,
                attempt_count = attempt_count + 1,
                first_attempt_at = COALESCE(first_attempt_at, now()),
                last_attempt_at = now(),
                next_attempt_at = NULL,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = $1
            RETURNING
                attempt_count,
                last_attempt_at AS "started_at!"
